title: Families
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How important is family in your life? Why?
What do you think makes a happy and healthy family?
Do you think people should always be honest with their family members? Why or why not?
How have families changed compared to the past in your country?
If you could change one thing about family life in today's world, what would it be and why?
